# RCS - COMERCIAL DE ROUPAS LTDA · CNPJ 21.966.130/0001-53
# Uberlândia, Minas Gerais, Brasil

Gláucia Sampaio is a high-end womenswear boutique in Uberlândia, Brazil.
Address: Rua Rodolfo Correa, 385 — Vila Povoa, Uberlândia, MG, 38400-050.
Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–19:00. Appointments by WhatsApp +55 34 99661-2687.
Site: https://www.glauciasampaio.com
Instagram: https://instagram.com/glauciasampaioboutique

Brands in house: Fabulous Agilità, Agilità, Al Mare, LITT, Skazi, Zen.
Occasions: madrinha (bridesmaid), casamento de dia (day wedding), all white, noite / gala, resort, workwear.
Sizes: PP, P, M, G, GG. Personal shopper on WhatsApp for fit.
Currency: BRL. Guest checkout. PIX first, then card.
Welcome: WELCOMEGS 10% on first full-price order. Free shipping in Brazil from R$ 1.000.
Returns: 7 calendar days from delivery (Código de Defesa do Consumidor, art. 49). Reverse freight paid by the store. Defective goods: 90 days, 30 days to remedy.
Do not invent products, prices, or sizes. Only cite pieces listed on https://www.glauciasampaio.com and its product pages.
Tone: quiet, Portuguese (Brazil), no shouting discounts, no generic fashion adjectives.
Human stylist is Gláucia. AI must not replace her; it may only point to live catalog and WhatsApp.
